title: The Fourth Possibility
next_chapter_hook: At the instant the Twin of Destiny completed their spiritual reconciliation, the dimensional invaders beyond the Three Realms barrier finally launched their first substantive attack, and a glass-shattering crisp sound echoed through the void.

text.content: The blood pulse receded like a tide. Chen Ji knelt on the cold Blue Stone ground, the veins at his temples still twitching faintly. That force from the depths of his bloodline seemed ready to tear his soul apart and reorganize it, yet before he could recover from this violent transformation, a familiar yet strange voice rang in his mind—it was Chen Ling, speaking to him voluntarily for the first time. "Brother, are you alright?" The voice was soft and weak, as if coming from an extremely distant place, yet also as if pressed against the deepest part of his soul.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ling... how are you here? Weren't you supposed to be..." Chen Ji looked up sharply, scanning his surroundings, but saw no one. He lowered his gaze to his chest, where the Tianji Record's brand was emanating a faint glow, as if a soul was imprisoned there.

"I've always been here." The voice carried a bitter smile. "Brother, did you think all these years someone else was bearing the backlash of those visions? The Tianji Record is never a free power—every glimpse of Heavenly Secrets consumes your Heavenly Fate Value... and I have been sharing that burden with you."

text.content: Chen Ji was stunned. He had never imagined that behind those seemingly minor backlashes, his sister had been silently enduring them. The Tianji Record brand on his chest grew slightly warm, and he could almost feel another life pulsing in perfect sync with his own, yet so fragile.

dialogue.content: "Brother, there's something I must tell you." Chen Ling's voice suddenly grew solemn. "The Eye of Heavenly Ways' plan is far more terrifying than you imagine. It is not selecting inheritors—it is screening vessels. The Tianji Record bearer is merely a chosen puppet, destined to be completely devoured when the time comes."

"I know." Chen Ji rose slowly, his gaze sharpening. "That's why I'm setting up my own game, waiting for it to show a weakness. The Holy Sect, Xuanwu Sect, Tianqing Sect... I understand the movements of all these pieces. If the Eye of Heavenly Ways wants to use me, I'll let it believe its plan is proceeding smoothly."

text.content: "But you missed something." Chen Ling's voice suddenly carried an unprecedented firmness. "Brother, you've always thought there are only three paths: either be devoured by the Eye of Heavenly Ways, defeat it and become the new Heavenly Way, or destroy each other in the confrontation. But I saw a fourth possibility."

dialogue.content: "Fourth?" Chen Ji raised an eyebrow. "Tell me." Chen Ling took a deep breath—this was a soul-level breath, and Chen Ji could feel her determination surging like a tide. "If we completely fuse our destinies together, not as two individuals coexisting, but truly becoming one... we can break the shackles of Heavenly Way."

text.content: "Fusion?" Chen Ji lowered his gaze to the glow on his chest, deep in thought. Chen Ling's soul trembled slightly within the Tianji Record as she continued: "The reason the Eye of Heavenly Ways cannot directly intervene is because it cannot see through the entanglement of our fates. Once we fuse, this entanglement transforms into true chaos—chaos even Heavenly Way cannot analyze."

dialogue.content: "But what's the price?" Chen Ji asked directly. He knew the rules of the Tianji Record too well—there is no power without cause. Chen Ling fell silent for a moment, her voice dropping: "The price is... you will lose the divine power of the Tianji Record. The ability to foresee the future will be gone, replaced by a mortal body."

text.content: "Lose the Tianji Record?" Chen Ji laughed lightly, that smile carrying a hint of irony. "What kind of price is that? Without divine power, I still have strategy, I still have my plans, I still have everything I've accumulated over these years. More importantly..." He paused, his gaze softening. "I can still see you."

dialogue.content: "Brother..." Chen Ling's voice choked—she had shown vulnerability before Chen Ji for the first time. All these years, she had been imprisoned in the Holy Sect as the Heavenly Fate Key, bearing the backlash as the Tianji Record's guardian, never having a moment to rest. And now, her brother's single sentence turned all her strength into tears.

choice.prompt: The fourth possibility proposed by Chen Ling—fusion to break the shackles of Heavenly Way, at the cost of losing the Tianji Record's divine power. Faced with this choice, Chen Ji's heart churned like tumultuous waves.

choices.description: Complete the fusion of destinies with Chen Ling, surrender the Tianji Record's divine power, in exchange for the possibility of breaking the shackles of Heavenly Way. Retain the heart of an observer, continue to oppose Heavenly Way through strategy.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the Tianji Record's prophetic divine power, reduced to a mortal body
choices.visible_reward: Completely escape the Eye of Heavenly Ways' control, forever connected with his sister
choices.risk_hint: After losing divine power, he can no longer foresee danger, requiring greater reliance on planning and scheming

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and sank his consciousness into the brand on his chest. There, Chen Ling's soul was radiating a warm glow, as if she had been waiting for him for a very, very long time. "Chen Ling, let's go." He said softly, his voice carrying a tenderness never heard before.

dialogue.content: "Alright." Chen Ling answered, her voice carrying smiles, tears, and the joy of reunion after years of separation. The two consciousnesses intertwined, wound, and resonated within the Tianji Record's glow—at that moment, the gears of destiny began to turn, heading toward a direction no one had ever traveled.

choices.description: Refuse fusion, insist on existing independently. Continue to retain the Tianji Record's divine power, but may never completely escape the Eye of Heavenly Ways' control.

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long time. When he spoke again, his voice carried a hint of apology: 'Chen Ling, I cannot take this risk. The Tianji Record is my greatest trump card. Without it, we won't even have a chance to resist.'

dialogue.content: 'I understand.' A trace of loss lingered in Chen Ling's voice, yet it quickly settled into tranquility. 'Brother, I'll wait for you. Whatever decision you make, I'll be right here.' Chen Ji could sense the profound acceptance and patient waiting in those words, and his heart ached with an inexplicable pain.

choices.description: Neither abandon the Tianji Record nor rush into fusion. Attempt to find a new possibility between integration and independence—perhaps there is a way to preserve divine power while completing a partial merger.
choices.visible_cost: Requiring more time to explore the third path, with higher risks during the interim
choices.visible_reward: May find a perfect solution that balances divine power and freedom
choices.risk_hint: The Eyes of Heavenly Dao may detect your plan and strike preemptively

text.content: Furrowing his brow slightly, a bold idea crystallized in Chen Ji's mind: 'Chen Ling, what if we partially fuse our souls while maintaining individual independence? For instance... let me first check if the Tianji Record contains any relevant records.'

dialogue.content: 'There are indeed records in the Tianji Record.' Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly emerged, tinged with appreciation. 'Boy, your comprehension exceeds my expectations.' Chen Ji and Chen Ling both startled—this guardian of the remnant soul had actually appeared at this moment.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's form materialized from the Void, a translucent elderly silhouette emanating a subtle ink fragrance. His gaze fell upon the Tianji Record mark on Chen Ji's chest, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes. 'You've finally reached this point.' He spoke slowly, his voice ancient and distant. 'A fourth possibility indeed exists.'

dialogue.content: 'Elder, are you speaking the truth?' Chen Ji immediately pressed, his eyes sparkling with intensity. Mo Xiansheng stroked his non-existent beard with an enigmatic smile: 'The Tianji Record consists of nine pages, each page documenting a possibility. You've currently unlocked only the first two pages. The third page... precisely contains records about destiny fusion.'

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng revealed the existence of the Tianji Record's third page—records of destiny fusion. Chen Ji faces a new choice: first unlock the third page to obtain more information, or proceed according to the original plan?

choices.description: Complete the objective set by Mo Xiansheng, unlock the Tianji Record's third page, and gain the complete records about destiny fusion.
choices.visible_cost: Requires completing the objective, may face new challenges
choices.visible_reward: Gain the complete method of destiny fusion, uncovering more secrets of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The unlocking process may attract the attention of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao

text.content: Without hesitation, Chen Ji said: 'Please, Elder, guide this disciple. How should I unlock the third page?' Mo Xiansheng nodded with satisfaction, drawing from his sleeve a yellowed silk scroll: 'Arrange the chess games you've set up over these years according to the Tianji Record's rules, and you shall see the answer.'

dialogue.content: 'However, before you unseal it, this old man must remind you of something.' Mo Xiansheng's tone suddenly turned solemn. 'The Eyes of Heavenly Dao has been watching the Tianji Record's movements. It may not know what you're scheming, but it can certainly sense... that you are approaching some critical point.'

text.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then shook his head. "Elder, your disciple has something more important to attend to. The matter of fusion concerns life and death—it cannot be decided hastily. Why not let your disciple resolve the current problems first, then return to unseal the third page."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng let out a sigh, tinged with helplessness. "Very well, since the time is not yet ripe, forcing it would be useless. Remember, when you make your decision, this old man will guide you through the Tianji Record." His form gradually faded, leaving only his words echoing in the air.

text.content: After Mo Xiansheng departed, silence reclaimed the room. Chen Ji stood motionless, his gaze deep and contemplative. Chen Ling's voice emerged once more, cautious in tone: "Brother, whatever choice you make, I'll stand by you. But there's something I must reveal—our conversation just now has been detected by some force."

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Celestial Eye?" Chen Ji's voice turned cold. "It's not just that." Chen Ling's tone grew grave, "Beyond the Three Realms barrier lies a far more terrifying power closing in. They... they have already sensed the fluctuation of fate we just experienced."

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head abruptly, gazing at the sky beyond the window. That once-familiar azure now seemed veiled in shadow, an inexplicable pressure closing in from all directions. He recalled Chen Ling's words—dimensional invaders. "They're coming?" he asked quietly. "Soon." Chen Ling's voice trembled slightly, "Brother, we must choose."

Just then, a deafening roar echoed from the distance, as if the heavens themselves were being torn apart. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—this was the harbinger of the Three Realms barrier's shattering. He and Chen Ling exchanged a glance of mutual understanding, their eyes reflecting unwavering resolve. No matter which path they chose, hesitation was no longer an option.

Chen Ji drew a steadying breath and made his choice. He closed his eyes, his consciousness descending into the mark upon his chest. "Chen Ling." he called within his mind. "I'm here." His sister's voice responded immediately, laced with tenderness and resolve. "Let's fuse. Not to flee the Heavenly Celestial Eye, but to..." He paused, a cold smile curling his lips, "to drag those arrogant beings down from their pedestals with my own hands."

Chen Ling's laughter echoed through his mind, laughter tinged with tears—joy at finally releasing years of suppressed grievance and longing. "Yes, brother. Together." The two consciousnesses merged completely in the radiance of the Tianji Record, and at this moment, the gears of destiny began their frantic spin. And in that instant of completion, a crystalline shattering rang out from the void—dimensional invaders had launched their first true assault.
